teaser: By the end of a late shift, when the last voice has gone quiet and the register's been counted twice just to be sure, you are the one who stays to tidy a breakroom nobody asked you to tidy. Life path 2 and the INFJ cross here, in that extra lap around the room. The 2 wants harmony kept intact; the INFJ wants the quieter story behind why someone snapped earlier. Where another number would clock out, you are reading what got left unsaid. What is specific here is how completely both sides trust a feeling to be more reliable than a fact.
